02 / SELECTED WORK
IDEAS INVESTIGATED · DISCOVERIES DEVELOPED · INNOVATIONS RECOGNISED

Ideas investigated.
Innovations recognised.

My work spans pharmaceutical research, cancer-related innovation, drug delivery, computational approaches, and healthcare technology. Each project investigates a scientific question and explores practical healthcare possibilities.

GYTI Award · SRISTI–Honey Bee Network Design Patent 414797-001
01 · Healthcare Innovation & Medical Device Design

A Home-Based Cervical Cancer Self-Sampling Device

Developed an innovative cervical cancer self-sampling device designed to address barriers to screening and encourage more accessible participation in cervical cancer screening—combining pharmaceutical knowledge, medical device design, and practical healthcare needs.

Ongoing Research Concept Formulation Development
Nanomedicine · Advanced Drug Delivery · Pharmaceutical Innovation

Dissolving Microneedle-Based Drug Delivery for Breast Cancer

An emerging research concept exploring dissolving microneedle technology as a potential approach for the topical delivery of drug-loaded transfersomal formulations. Incorporating drug-loaded transfersomes into a dissolving polymeric microneedle system aims to investigate localised delivery, formulation feasibility, and improved drug delivery characteristics.

Drug-loaded transfersomes Dissolving microneedle technology Polymeric drug delivery systems Nanocarrier integration Formulation optimisation Pharmaceutical characterisation
CONCEPTUAL 3D ILLUSTRATION ONGOING FORMULATION RESEARCH
Original Research · Elsevier (2026) Co-First & Corresponding Author
02 · Journal of Molecular Structure · India × Thailand

Exploring the Anti-Inflammatory, Antioxidant, and Antimicrobial Activities of Brassica oleracea L.: In Vitro and In Silico Assessments

Experimental phytochemistry, cytotoxicity, LPS-induced NO inhibition, COX-2 molecular docking, and fortified hydrogel formulation in collaboration between SMBT College of Pharmacy (India) and Chiang Mai University (Thailand).

Read the publication ↗
Review Article · Elsevier (2026) First & Corresponding Author
03 · Next Research · Vol. 12, 102177

Advances in Stem Cell-Based Oncology: Therapeutic Mechanism, Nanotechnology, and Synergies

Examines mesenchymal stem cells, induced pluripotent stem cells, and cancer stem cells—detailing exosome paracrine signaling, tumor-homing capabilities, immunomodulation, nanotechnology, and 3D bioprinting synergies in oncology.

Read the publication ↗
04 · CANCER RESEARCH Published + Ongoing

Research on Anisomeles Species: Anticancer Potential & Biological Applications

Phytochemical investigation and biological activity assessment of medicinal Anisomeles species through experimental and computational methods—building on published Anisomeles heyneana formulation work (2022) alongside ongoing anticancer and wound-healing manuscripts in preparation.

05 · NANOMEDICINE Under Development

AI-Guided Development of Drug-Loaded Transfersomes for Breast Cancer Drug Delivery

Ongoing formulation research exploring drug-loaded transfersomes, formulation optimization, computational drug investigation, and a proposed dissolving microneedle topical delivery concept (research under development; not a clinically approved therapy).

TransfersomesDrug-Loaded MicroneedlesDissolving Microneedles
06 · HEALTHCARE AI 1st Rank Poster · 2024

AI-Driven Skin Cancer Detection from Smartphone Images

Academic innovation investigating how artificial intelligence and smartphone-based image analysis can support accessible skin cancer screening. Awarded First-Rank Poster at the International Conference on Innovative Pharmacy, Amrutvahini (March 2024).

05 / RESEARCH JOURNEY
LEARNING THROUGH EXPERIMENTS · GROWING THROUGH COLLABORATION

Learning through
experiments.
Growing through collaboration.

From early medicinal-plant investigations to structured zebrafish research training, international co-authorship, and national healthcare innovation recognition.

2022 – 2023

Research Foundations — Anisomeles Research

Early research involvement in medicinal plant extraction, formulation development (Anisomeles heyneana, 2022), and biological screening with growing focus on anticancer potential and wound healing.

2024

Research Communication & AI Innovation Recognition

Awarded First-Rank Poster at the International Conference on Innovative Pharmacy, Amrutvahini (March 2024) for academic innovation on AI-driven skin cancer detection from smartphone images.

2025

Zebrafish Research Training & Lab Contribution

Completed formal hands-on training through ZebCoG/MGM covering zebrafish husbandry, water-quality management, breeding and embryo handling, embryo sorting, oral exposure and dermal injection, fish embryo toxicity testing, behavioural observations, histopathology, and microinjection. Separately contributed to subsequent zebrafish laboratory setup at the institutional level.

2026

GYTI Award & International Elsevier Publications

Recognised with the Grassroots and Young Technological Innovation (GYTI) Award (SRISTI–Honey Bee Network) for the home-based cervical cancer self-sampling device (Design Patent 414797-001), alongside first-author and co-first-author Elsevier publications and book chapters.

PRESENT & NEXT

At the Intersection of Science & Healthcare Technology

Advancing ongoing research in cancer biology, targeted nanomedicine (drug-loaded transfersomes and dissolving microneedles), computational drug discovery, and international scientific collaborations.
